children: Overview
UK vanadium flow battery maker's H1 2026 revenue rose yr/yr, driven by increased project deliveries
Gross loss for H1 narrowed by 62%, reflecting improved margins and reduced warranty costs
Net loss for H1 widened 14% yr/yr due to increased R&D investment
Outlook
Company says trading remains in line with management expectations for the full yr
Revenue recognition for 2026 expected to be strongly weighted to H2, subject to project delivery
Orderbook provides coverage for most 2026 and over half of 2027 expected revenue
Result Drivers
PROJECT DELIVERIES - Revenue growth attributed to increased customer project delivery activity, including completion of one battery system and commissioning of four projects
COST REDUCTION PROGRAMME - Gross loss narrowed due to improved product margins from cost reduction efforts, reduced warranty costs, and increased manufacturing activity
R&D INVESTMENT - Net loss widened due to increased administrative expenses, mainly higher staff costs and reduced R&D grant income as company invested in product cost reduction
